period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported), Solo basis, from First Security Islami Bank PLC's own Condensed Balance Sheet (Un-audited) as at 2025-03-31. Income-statement items with a '_cumulative' suffix are cumulative from 1 January of the same year; items with a '_discrete_q' suffix are the single discrete quarter alone -- both are printed directly as separate columns in the source document (not derived by subtraction), so both carry basis='reported'. OUTSIDE this dataset's core FY2011-2024 annual coverage (which ends at FY2024, the bank's last audited year as an independent entity) but included here as genuinely-sourced, valuable post-collapse trajectory context, per this task's request to extract 'as many years as you can'. The comparative prior-year-end Total Assets column in this filing cross-validates exactly (to the taka, after rounding) against this dataset's already-stored 691,205.74mn (2024_Q4.json) total_assets figure, confirming Solo basis continuity and no restatement between the audited annual figure and this interim filing's own comparative column. Filed/signed 2025-05-29, the SAME DAY the Board adopted the audited FY2024 financial statements (per this bank's own sources.json). Jan-Mar 2025 Net Profit After Tax was BDT -5,755.73mn -- a catastrophic quarterly loss roughly 1.4x the size of the ENTIRE FY2024 reported annual loss (BDT -3,993.40mn), driven primarily by Net Investment Income itself turning NEGATIVE (BDT -3,571.62mn: Profit Paid on Deposits of BDT 10,424.43mn EXCEEDED Investments Income of BDT 6,852.81mn), i.e. a genuine earning-asset/liquidity crisis, not just a provisioning charge. Solo Total Shareholders' Equity fell from BDT 20,069.13mn (31-Dec-2024, matching 2024_Q4.json exactly) to BDT 14,313.40mn (31-Mar-2025) -- a drop that reconciles exactly to the quarter's own reported net loss, confirming no other equity transactions occurred. UNAUDITED.

line_items.metric_note: Simple Investment/Deposit calculation per this dataset's standard formula (methodology.md). This does NOT match the bank's own regulatory-basis 'Investment Deposit Ratio' as separately disclosed in annual reports (e.g. FY2024 annual reports 122.25% vs this simple calculation giving ~141% at FY2024 year-end) -- the bank's own regulatory ratio evidently uses a different deposit/investment base (e.g. including borrowings or a regulatory-defined denominator) not disclosed in these condensed interim statements. Recorded as a internally-consistent, comparable-across-quarters proxy, not as a reproduction of the bank's own regulatory ratio.
